questions.prompt: In Figma, which mode is a collection's default mode?

options.text: The mode used on most frames
options.explanation: Figma ties the default to the column position, not to how often a mode is used: it is the left-most column.
Right. Figma says the default mode of a collection is the left-most column.
Mode names are your own. Figma uses the left-most column as the default, whatever its name.

questions.prompt: In a Penpot theme group such as Mode (Light, Dark), how many themes can be active at once?

options.explanation: Right. Penpot says only one of the themes in a group can be active. Themes from other groups, like Brand, can be active too.
Penpot says only one theme in a group can be active, so you pick Light or Dark.
Groups decide what can be active together. Penpot allows one active theme per group.

questions.prompt: A DTCG resolver file has a theme modifier and a brand modifier. What must a tool get before it can produce final tokens?

options.text: An input that picks one context per modifier
options.explanation: Right. The spec calls the chosen contexts an input, and tools should throw an error if no input is provided.

options.text: A screenshot of the target screen
options.explanation: The resolver works on token files, not pictures. It needs an input such as theme: dark.

options.text: Nothing: it always builds every context
options.explanation: The spec says tools should throw an error when a resolver with modifiers comes with no input.
